description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EndpointTestCase' for unit testing API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It provides utility methods for creating mock requests, asserting exceptions related to API error handling, and setting up mocks for API endpoint classes. It imports various exception classes, request classes, and traits needed for testing.

classes.name: EndpointTestCase
classes.description: Abstract base class for API endpoint unit tests, providing methods to create mock requests, set expectations for exceptions, and build endpoint mock objects.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Request object with specified query, request, and attribute parameters.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMockBuilder
methods.description: Builds and returns a mock object for a specified API class, initialized with a mocked Request.

methods.name: expectNotImplementedException
methods.description: Sets up the test to expect a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: expectRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Sets up the test to expect a RecordNotFoundException.

methods.name: expectBadRequestException
methods.description: Sets up the test to expect a BadRequestException.

methods.name: expectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Sets up the test to expect an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: expectForbiddenException
methods.description: Sets up the test to expect a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: assertInvalidParamException
methods.description: Executes a closure and asserts that it throws an InvalidParamException with specified invalid parameters.
